title: Smarter Swipe Engine Deck
project: Swipe and Type (trademark), Swipe Decks engine upgrades
example_data: Engine options shown as small HTML/CSS mockups (no generated images).

pairs.ask: How does the deck pick the next pair?

optionA.label: Adaptive
optionA.desc: The next pair is chosen from your last answers.
optionA.more: You picked warm twice, so the next pair tests warm against something new. Fewer wasted cards.

optionB.label: Fixed order
optionB.desc: Every deck runs in the order it was built.
optionB.more: Simple and predictable. Everyone sees the same pairs in the same order, so results are easy to compare.

optionA.label: Speed counts
optionA.desc: A fast pick reads as a sure pick. A slow one as unsure.
optionA.more: Time per card is saved with each answer. Quick picks weigh more in your taste profile.

optionB.label: Just the pick
optionB.desc: Only what you chose counts. Take as long as you like.
optionB.more: No clock, no pressure. A slow pick weighs the same as a fast one.

pairs.ask: What happens when you can’t decide?

optionA.label: Bonus card
optionA.desc: A quick tie-breaker pair pops in to settle it.
optionA.more: If you hit Both or slow down, one extra pair with a sharper difference shows up. Then the deck carries on.

optionB.label: Move on
optionB.desc: No extra cards. Unsure stays unsure.
optionB.more: The deck keeps its length. Both and Neither are saved as they are.

pairs.ask: When do you see what the deck is learning?

optionA.label: Live meter
optionA.desc: A small taste meter fills in as you swipe.
optionA.more: A strip at the top shows what is winning so far. Fun to watch, but it may nudge your picks.

optionB.label: Reveal at the end
optionB.desc: Swipe blind. See it all at once when you finish.
optionB.more: No hints while you swipe, so every pick is fresh. The end screen does the big reveal.

pairs.ask: How do you add a note?

optionA.label: Voice note
optionA.desc: Hold to talk. A few words, turned into text.
optionA.more: Faster than typing on a phone. Good for free thoughts. The text is saved with the card.

optionB.label: Typed note
optionB.desc: A fold-down box under each card.
optionB.more: Quiet and exact. Works anywhere, no mic needed. What the decks use today.

pairs.ask: When you tap Both, what does it say?

optionA.label: Love both
optionA.desc: Both is a yes. Both options count up.
optionA.more: Both feeds your profile like two picks. Use Neither when nothing fits.

optionB.label: Can’t choose
optionB.desc: Both means torn. It is saved as a tie.
optionB.more: A tie tells the engine this pair was too close. Useful for picking the next pair.

optionA.label: Undo button
optionA.desc: One tap takes back the last swipe.
optionA.more: Slips happen on a phone. Undo is also a habit signal: lots of undos means the pair was hard.

optionB.label: No undo
optionB.desc: Every swipe is final. Trust the gut.
optionB.more: Keeps it fast and honest. You can still fix picks on the review page at the end.

pairs.ask: What do you get at the end?

optionA.label: Taste profile card
optionA.desc: One card that sums up your taste in a few words.
optionA.more: Short, shareable, easy to remember. Built from all your picks, Loves and notes.

optionB.label: Ranked list
optionB.desc: Every pick in order, from most loved down.
optionB.more: Shows the detail behind the result. Better for building the next thing from.

pairs.ask: How long should a deck be?

optionA.label: 10 + follow-up
optionA.desc: Ten quick cards, then a short next deck built from them.
optionA.more: Done in a minute or two. The follow-up digs into what you picked.

optionB.label: 20 in one go
optionB.desc: One longer deck. Finish once, done.
optionB.more: Fewer stops. More cards before any result, so it can drag at the end.

optionA.label: From your Neithers
optionA.desc: The engine turns your Neithers into new pairs, on its own.
optionA.more: Every Neither says “not this”. The next deck tries fresh options there, ready right away.

optionB.label: Hand-built
optionB.desc: Swatch reads your picks and builds the next deck.
optionB.more: Slower, but each pair is chosen with care and can use your notes.

optionA.label: Swipe and Type
optionA.desc: Spelled out in full. Calm and clear.
optionA.more: Reads like a sentence. Easy to say out loud.

optionB.label: Swipe & Type
optionB.desc: With an ampersand. Shorter, more like a logo.
optionB.more: The & ties the two halves together and fits small spaces.

optionA.label: Khand caps
optionA.desc: Tall, tight capitals. Strong and sporty.
optionA.more: Matches the deck labels and buttons. Bold at small sizes.

optionB.label: Hind lowercase
optionB.desc: Soft, friendly lowercase. Quiet and warm.
optionB.more: Feels personal and calm, closer to free writing. Less loud on a busy page.

pairs.ask: A small mark next to the name?

optionA.label: Card + cursor
optionA.desc: A tilted card with a typing cursor beside it.
optionA.more: The card is the swipe, the cursor is the note. Works alone as an app icon.

optionB.label: Words only
optionB.more: Clean and simple. The swipe itself is the picture.
